title: Comparative transcriptional analysis identified characteristic genes and patterns in HIV-infected immunological non-responders
description: The incomplete immune reconstitution is a complex phenomenon among human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patients despite they have achieved persistent viral suppression under the combined antiretroviral therapy. The aim of this study is to screen and verify the immunological characteristics and underlying mechanisms of immunological non-responders (INRs).
